target: 2m air temperature at exact archived observation time; not continuous night minimum
selection: Expanding-year validation: train2022->2023; train2022-2023->2024. Equal-year MAE; candidate requires >=5% reduction in both years, cold-slot MAE no worse in either year, and no additional false-cold complete sampled nights in either year. Otherwise retain GFS. Ties by registry order.

bootstrap.unit: 7-night calendar blocks within each validation year

controls: 2025-2026 targets forbidden in preparation, fit and selection; no controls downloaded by this experiment
detector: Existing detector, probability, threshold, mask, timing and routing unchanged. Zero-crossings below are temperature diagnostics only.
